ordinary_guard_method.semantics: A required dependency row with isST exactly string1 raises; missing/invalid explicit isST also raises. A positive frozen target requires its as_of close snapshot. tradestatus0 is reported separately and is not itself the isST guard.

scope_limitations: Checks only mandatory positive-weight target prior-close snapshots; does not infer actual holdings, future pending entitlements/orders, or account dependency states.
A covered ordinary target snapshot does not certify the entire holding interval, lifecycle, tax, raw-source completeness or execution eligibility.
Unknown60names and their required snapshots remain unknown; no unknown source is promoted to ordinary.
Existing target and source bytes are unchanged. No source or strategy rule is relaxed to avoid a conflict.
